metadata.title: Samuele La Fleur — Full Stack Software Engineer
metadata.description: Personal portfolio of Samuele La Fleur, Full Stack Software Engineer based in Switzerland. Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, TypeScript, React, Next.js, AWS.

hero.tagline: 4+ years of professional experience across healthcare, Web3, and SaaS. Backend focus on Java / Spring Boot and Node.js, frontend on TypeScript / React, with production experience on serverless AWS and Kubernetes.

about.heading: What I work on.
about.p1: Full stack software engineer based in Switzerland. For over four years I've worked on systems that run in production: electronic health records in a hospital setting, a Web3 e-commerce platform, SaaS applications on AWS.
about.p2: Backend in Java / Spring Boot and Node.js, frontend in TypeScript and React. Deployed on serverless AWS and Kubernetes, with tests where they actually matter (JUnit 5, Mockito, Jest).
about.personalLine: Off the keyboard: strength training, music across genres, open source and side projects, AC Milan.
